    StartersSitka smoked salmonRye crispbread with cream cheese, smoked salmon, dill and capersHow to make it8 rye crispbreads150g cream cheese200g smoked salmon4 sprigs of dill1 tbsp capers1 lemonSpread the crispbreads with cream cheese.Top with folds of smoked salmon, a sprig of dill and a few capers.Squeeze over a little lemon just before serving.Welcome party crab dipCrab, cream cheese and spring onion baked until golden and bubblingHow to make it250g crab meat250g cream cheese2 tbsp mayonnaise2 spring onions1 box water crackersSlice the spring onions and mix with the crab, cream cheese and mayonnaise.Spread in a small dish and bake at 190°C until golden and bubbling.Serve hot with water crackers.Ramone's general store reindeer sausage rollsRamone runs the store, the bar and the weddingHow to make it500g smoked sausage meat1 onion, finely diced1 tsp dried sage1 tsp smoked paprika3 sheets of frozen puff pastry1 egg2 tbsp hot English mustardHeat the oven to 200°C. Mix the sausage meat with the onion, sage and paprika.Pipe or roll the mix along each pastry sheet, roll up and brush with beaten egg.Cut into pieces and bake until puffed and golden.Serve hot with mustard.King crab legs with garlic butterKevin stays inside tonight. Eagles about.How to make itA house standard, not part of tonight's cook.MainsAlaskan salmon dinnerRoast salmon glazed with maple and wholegrain mustard, baby potatoes, green beansHow to make it4 salmon fillets2 tbsp maple syrup1 tbsp wholegrain mustard800g baby potatoes300g green beans50g buttersalt and pepper, to tasteSeason the salmon with salt and pepper. Mix the maple syrup and mustard and brush over the salmon.Roast the salmon at 200°C until just cooked through. While it roasts, boil the potatoes.Steam the green beans, then toss with the potatoes and butter.Serve everything together.Barn wedding pot roast and horseradishThe wedding set up in the family barnHow to make itAs written, serves 4Beef chuck braised for 3 hours with onion, carrots and stock, potatoes added late, sliced with pot gravy and a sharp horseradish cream.Season a 1.5kg beef chuck roast and brown all over in a heavy pot.Add 2 quartered onions, 3 carrots in chunks, 2 garlic cloves, 1 tbsp tomato paste, thyme and 500ml beef stock.Cover and braise at 160°C for 2 hours.Add 800g potatoes in chunks and braise 1 hour more.Lift out the beef and veg, thicken the liquid with 1 tbsp cornflour mixed with water and pour the gravy over the sliced beef.Mix 150g sour cream with 2 tbsp grated horseradish and a squeeze of lemon to serve on the side.SweetsBarn wedding cakeButter sponge layers with strawberry jam and whipped cream, icedHow to make it250g butter, softened250g caster sugar4 eggs250g self-raising flour150g strawberry jam300ml thickened cream250g icing sugar1 tbsp milk1 bunch edible flowers, to decorateBeat the butter and sugar, add the eggs, then fold in the flour. Divide between 2 tins.Bake at 175°C until golden and springy.Cool the cakes completely.Whip the cream, sandwich the cakes with jam and cream, then ice white with icing sugar mixed with milk.Top with fresh flowers.DrinksMargaret's iced vanilla latteEspresso with vanilla bean syrup and milk over iceHow to make it80g caster sugar80ml water1 vanilla bean300ml strong coffee or 4 double shots espresso800ml full cream milk4 cups iceSimmer the sugar, water and split vanilla bean for 3 minutes, then cool.Make the espresso and cool for 5 minutes.Fill 4 tall cups with ice, then add a spoonful of vanilla syrup and the cold milk to each.Pour the espresso over the top, stir and serve with lids and straws.Alaskan amber aleTo the window, to the wall.
